vocalists.name: Irina
vocalists.tagline: Powerful delivery, major pop programs and a world-class stage presence.
vocalists.bio: Irina leads pop, retro and modern mainstream blocks with strong vocals, confident movement and long experience on large stages.

vocalists.name: Stas
vocalists.tagline: He sings, hosts audience interaction and works as an MC. He releases original songs as Zace.
vocalists.bio: He performs pop, pop-rock, rock, retro, disco, funk, soul, R&B and dance music. He leads audience interaction and sings in duets and trios with Irina. He releases his own songs as Zace.

vocalists.name: Teddy
vocalists.tagline: A Cuban vocalist and bassist. In the Latin programme he sings, dances and invites guests to join the Macarena.
vocalists.bio: Teddy Fuentes comes from Guantanamo. A bassist, vocalist and composer, he founded Bumbata in Moscow and recorded the album Timba con nieve with the band. In Russia, he has worked with 2 Mashi, Alexey Chumakov, Pizza, Dimash and Egor Kreed.

vocalists.name: Lazzy
vocalists.tagline: Black Eyed Peas hits and English-language dance sets in the band’s style.
vocalists.bio: His repertoire also includes soul and R&B. Alongside his cover performances, he releases original tracks and music videos.
story: Lazzy performs a tribute to the Black Eyed Peas: the band's hits and English-language dance sets in their style. His repertoire also includes soul and R&B.

His musical favourites include The Weeknd, the Black Eyed Peas and Avril Lavigne. He describes his approach this way: ‘I received my musical education in all genres in English, so I will sing whatever I want. What matters to me is an emotional connection with the song and understanding what it is about.’ Alongside his cover performances, Lazzy releases his own tracks and music videos.
